title.zh: 将达沃省班萨兰市镇基亚莱格村的名称变更为Magsaysay村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Kialeg in the Municipality of Bansalan, Province of Davao, to Barrio Magsaysay
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Kialeg in the Municipality of Bansalan, Province of Davao, to Barrio Magsaysay
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Kialeg tại Thị trấn Bansalan, Tỉnh Davao thành Barrio Magsaysay
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Kialeg ในเทศบาล Bansalan, จังหวัด Davao เป็นบารริโอ Magsaysay
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Kialeg di Kotamadya Bansalan, Provinsi Davao menjadi Barrio Magsaysay
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Kialeg di Perbandaran Bansalan, Wilayah Davao menjadi Barrio Magsaysay

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2106_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Kialeg in the Municipality of Bansalan, Province of Davao, is changed to Barrio Magsaysay.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 3, 1959.
